title: rd-quartics-classification: rational-derived quartics with a repeated root - proof gap, unconditional repair (Theorem 7'), and Lean 4 formalization
description: Machine-verified analysis of Buchholz-MacDougall (J. Number Theory 81 (2000)) Theorem 7: a human-audited formal transcription of the printed proof with kernel certificates of the gap; an unconditional repair (Theorem 7'); the classification restated via rational points of the elliptic curve 576i2; and the boundary analysis in which the kernel theorem conjecture1_iff_terrain identifies Conjecture 1 with the nonexistence of nondegenerate rational points on the splitting terrain, whose three covers are obstructed in the kernel. 137 checked declarations on the standard three axioms; two-system computer-algebra evidence re-executed in CI inside a digest-pinned container; fail-closed release and line-pin audits. Conjecture 1 itself remains open: this repository maps its boundary, it does not resolve it.
